pub(in crate::adapters::persistence::workflow) fn context(facts: &RunFacts) -> ActionPolicyContext {
    ActionPolicyContext {
        integration: None,
        origin: crate::application::agent::ToolCallOrigin::Workflow,
        actor: facts.actor.user_id(),
        capability_ceiling: facts
            .bundle
            .snapshots()
            .tools
            .iter()
            .map(|tool| tool.policy.capability.clone())
            .collect::<std::collections::BTreeSet<_>>()
            .into_iter()
            .collect(),
        approval_required: false,
    }
}

pub enum AgentBuiltinTool {
    MessageSend,
    MessageReply,
    ListCompanyAgents,
    CreateAgent,
    CreateDeskForAgent,
    SearchKnowledge,
    /// The memory service tools (phase 05 E5), offered only while memory is enabled.
    SearchMemory,
    MemoryTimeline,
    MemoryDetails,
    SaveMemory,
    ReadEscalation,
    RespondToEscalation,
}
